text: Theorem 5 states that Algorithm 1, with coordinate-wise Gumbel(0,1) perturbations and the stated sample size and step size, simultaneously achieves internal and external regret O(sqrt(T ln N)) with probability at least 1-delta. Each iteration requires S calls to the smooth optimization oracle and a fixed-point computation with running time poly(T, log 1/delta).
title: Theorem 5: simultaneous internal and external regret O(sqrt(T ln N)) with a smooth oracle
